text:
P-waves and S-waves are produced in the ground during an earthquake.
Which statement about these waves is correct?
A
Only P-waves are transverse waves.
B
Only P-waves are longitudinal waves.
C
Both P-waves and S-waves are longitudinal waves.
D
Both P-waves and S-waves are transverse waves.

options.label: C
options.text: Both P-waves and S-waves are longitudinal waves.

options.label: D
options.text: Both P-waves and S-waves are transverse waves.
